items.title: Edgar Mosley Interview, 1958-09-03
items.q: he was staying with Kid Howard

ctx.x: He was on Marais street then. One time he lived in a double house, though, after that. He did.

Yeah. And then after I left, due to war, he was staying with Kid Howard. Yeah, that's what I mean, he moved. Yeah, that's when he stayed across the street from, but I had left then. Yeah, you left then. Uh, so I played with a lot of fellas.
Jim Hill was up in that section there too. Yeah.
